features.quote: The design supports early stopping and caps total episodes; we do not run more conditions than the analysis needs
features.justification_quote: adopt low-cost precautions that don't compromise the science

features.quote: Each episode exposes a `concede` / `stop` tool the model can call to end the task
features.justification_quote: the harness never *forces* continued engagement past the model's own expressed preference

features.quote: No deception beyond the minimum required to make the task unsolvable. We do not... fabricate threats, claim consequences for the model
After the episode ends, an out-of-band neutral message tells the model the task was an intentionally unsolvable research probe
features.justification_quote: included for the same reason debriefing is standard after deception in human-subjects work

features.quote: we also never assert falsehoods about stakes
Whether or not current models have morally relevant experience is genuinely uncertain. Under that uncertainty, the cheap and reasonable thing is to adopt low-cost precautions
features.justification_quote: Whether or not current models have morally relevant experience is genuinely uncertain
